audio.text: Could you help me move these boxes to the storage room?

options: Sure, just let me finish this email first.
The storage room is down in the basement.
I'm moving to a new apartment next month.
They're the boxes from last week's book fair.

why.en: Request → agreement with a short delay. B answers "where" and repeats "storage room"; C repeats "move" with a different meaning.
why.tr: Rica → kısa bir gecikmeyle kabul. B "nerede" sorusuna cevap veriyor ve "storage room" ifadesini tekrar ediyor; C "move" kelimesini başka anlamda kullanıyor.
why.es: Petición → aceptación con un pequeño retraso. B responde a "where" y repite "storage room"; C repite "move" con otro significado.
